title: Glowing popsicle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff7b0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff7b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ice1' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5f8f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9ec4'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ice2' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb347'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe08a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='stick' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e8c48a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c99a5b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x='43' y='62' width='14' height='30' rx='5' fill='url(#stick)'/>
  <rect x='46' y='64' width='4' height='24' rx='2' fill='#f6dcaa' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- popsicle body -->
  <rect x='24' y='8' width='52' height='58' rx='20' fill='url(#ice1)'/>
  <!-- drizzle top layer -->
  <path d='M24 30 Q24 8 44 8 Q64 8 76 18 Q74 30 60 28 Q46 34 34 28 Q26 30 24 30 Z' fill='url(#ice2)'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <path d='M34 18 Q36 14 42 13' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='44' rx='4' ry='9' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- sprinkles -->
  <rect x='50' y='38' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7ee0ff' transform='rotate(25 54 40)'/>
  <rect x='32' y='50' width='9' height='4' rx='2' fill='#b6ff7e' transform='rotate(-20 36 52)'/>
  <rect x='58' y='52' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#c9a0ff' transform='rotate(40 62 54)'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='56' r='2.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='40' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- drips -->
  <path d='M28 60 Q27 70 31 70 Q35 70 34 60 Z' fill='#ff7aa8'/>
  <path d='M66 62 Q65 74 69 74 Q73 74 72 62 Z' fill='#ff8ab4'/>
  <!-- bite -->
  <path d='M70 62 Q80 58 76 48 Q72 44 68 48 Z' fill='#1a1030'/>
</svg>
